name: India DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV

cancellation.capNote: Capped at the booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less; no compensation if an alternate flight is accepted.

voucherWarning.doNot: Don't accept a credit shell instead of a refund unless you want it.
voucherWarning.action: Ask for an alternate flight or a full refund in writing; complain on AirSewa if refused.
